name: ik-knowledge-assistant
description: Search, audit and extend the Interview Kickstart knowledge base (programs, courses, modules, topics, instructors, resources) through its MCP server. Acts as you, with your role; archive requests always need human approval.

kb_api_url.title: Knowledge base URL
kb_api_url.description: Base URL of the KB app, e.g. https://<app-host> (no trailing slash).

kb_mcp_token.title: KB API token
kb_mcp_token.description: Create one in the KB app: Settings → API tokens (starts with ikkb_). Acts as you.
